title: urvillea ulmacea f. lanceolata
intro: Urvillea ulmacea f. lanceolata, commonly known as "Flor de Jamaica", is a plant species in the family Celastraceae, known for its medicinal properties. It is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits of anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Urvillea ulmacea f. lanceolata include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and promoting wound healing, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of this plant help to modulate the immune system, protect against oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal activities.
